title: Feature Flag
description: One flag in the central registry. Classic Azure App Configuration feature flag model — a plain on/off per environment, no conditional filters. See ../README.md for why classic over the (preview) enhanced model.

name.description: Kebab-case flag key. Must match this file's name without the .json extension — scripts/validate.mjs checks this, the schema alone can't.

description.description: What the flag gates and why it exists. Not "what it does technically" — a reader should be able to tell from this alone whether the flag is still needed.

owner.description: A squad alias, not an individual — see the main access-model doc's reasoning on why group identities outlive the person who happened to add the flag.

expiry.description: ISO 8601 date. Every flag gets one, even a flag expected to live a long time — scripts/validate.mjs warns (doesn't yet fail) on a past expiry; see README's Known Gaps.

environments.description: All three required, always, even to explicitly set false — an omitted environment reads as 'forgotten', not 'off'.
